title: transpose_out retile — host-only out_plan re-partition filling the vector cores on starved grids
status: ADOPTED (rule V2) — primaries R1 +26.81% / R6 +19.90% e2e, all guardrails held, main untouched, Gate 0/3 bit-identical. Rule V1 REJECTED by its own preregistered guardrail (R2 -16.83% regression); V2 = same mechanism with the wave-overhead-calibrated scoring, criteria unchanged (iter5-style implementation fix, NOT a goalpost move).

mechanism.target: gqa.out_plan + new module-level helper _retile_out_plan (host-side plan rule ONLY; _transpose_v1 kernel body untouched; main kernels untouched)
mechanism.pathology_iter6_measured: transpose_out grid B*ceil(Nq/bm)*ceil(S/bn) = 1..32 tasks vs 40 vector slots on starved prefill shapes (R1: ONE task = 1/40 cores, 42.6 GB/s = 1.2% of L2 roof, tout 12.0us > main 10.6us)
mechanism.rule_V1_REJECTED: score = critical-path byte factor g = waves/blk only (min g, 1.10*g* eligibility, max-area tie-break, 0.8 hysteresis). Selected multi-wave small-box configs: R2 (1,32) 256 tasks/7 waves, R3 (1,128) 7 waves, R6 (1,64) 5 waves.
mechanism.rule_V2_ADOPTED: score = calibrated wall model pred = L + waves * max(W_OH, bytes_per_block/RATE) with L=3.0us (iter3 launch floor), W_OH=2.5us per block-wave (fit of the V1 multi-wave measurements: R2 (1,32) 21.66us/7 waves, R3 (1,128) 21.07/7, R6 (1,64) 15.71/5), RATE=80 GB/s critical-path per-core (family range 68-105 across blk=1..160). Tie-break: (round(pred,1), FEWEST WAVES first, more tasks, larger bn, larger bm) — every measured wave-1 fat-block config in this family fits the model, so ties stay in the empirically-validated regime. Hysteresis 0.8 (>=20% model gain) keeps adequate grids legacy (R4/c6 IDENTICAL). Retile only when legacy total < 40. bn floor keeps read bursts >= 2KB. Deterministic pure-Python; integrated out_plan verified EQUAL to the standalone rule on a 10710-shape sweep (0 mismatches).

framework_findings: transpose-family wall time on this platform = L + waves * max(W_OH ~= 2.5us, bytes_per_block / ~80GB/s): block-wave dispatch/drain overhead (~2.5us/wave) DOMINATES small-box multi-wave configs — a task-count-only or critical-byte-only scoring model (iter6 P1 card's '>= 40 tasks' heuristic included) mis-ranks configs by up to -16.8% e2e; wave-1 fat-block grids are the empirically safe optimum in the launch-bound-to-mid regime
per-core effective rate of the transpose family RISES as active blocks fall (blk3: ~105 GB/s, blk16: ~77 GB/s) — L2 contention scaling; conservative constant (80) keeps the rule ordering correct
out_plan retile is fully host-side: cache keys already carry (bm,bn) so both plans coexist per session with zero cross-contamination (A/B in one process is safe)
antipattern_check: performance-antipatterns.md re-checked for the new code: host-plan only, no new kernel code; the change REMOVES a parallelism-starvation pattern (1-32 tasks vs 40 slots). Legacy retained item unchanged (per-head AUTO ladder launches by block_num — iter1 §7.2 rationale stands). No new violations.
